Redragon GS520 Anvil RGB Desktop Gaming Speakers

 The Redragon GS520 Anvil RGB Desktop Gaming Speakers represent a remarkable advancement in compact audio engineering, specifically developed for gamers, movie enthusiasts, and music lovers who want to upgrade their desktop soundscape without sacrificing premium desk space. In modern gaming setups and digital battle stations, high-fidelity sound is just as critical as high-frame-rate visuals. Whether you are tracking enemy movement by listening for subtle footstep cues, immersing yourself in an atmospheric cinematic soundtrack, or simply enjoying your favorite daily music playlists, these advanced dual-channel speakers deliver crisp acoustic balance, rich mid-range frequencies, and surprising depth that transforms your regular PC setup into an engaging entertainment studio.

 Expertly tailored to blend effortlessly with contemporary PC builds, clean office layouts, and dynamic streaming spaces, the Redragon GS520 Anvil introduces a striking modern aesthetic highlighted by brilliant, customizable RGB lighting arrays. It effectively eliminates the need for bulky, space-consuming sound systems by offering a highly efficient 2.0 channel configuration that fits perfectly on smaller desks. With its plug-and-play connectivity, durable outer enclosure, and intuitive touch-sensitive control mechanisms, this premium desktop audio set provides the ideal combination of acoustic performance, operational simplicity, and beautiful visual flair to complete your daily multimedia experience.

 
 
 
 
 Dynamic RGB Atmosphere & Touch-Sensitive Control

 Vibrant Visual Lighting Effects with Effortless Mode Adjustments

 The Redragon GS520 Anvil is built to be a visual centerpiece for your desktop, featuring highly vibrant, front-facing RGB backlight zones that cast a brilliant glow across your gaming mousepad and keyboard setup. Audio is a deeply sensory experience, and matching high-quality sound with smooth color transitions creates an incredibly immersive environment. The integrated light bars cycle fluidly through distinct color patterns, injecting pure energy into dark gaming environments and perfectly completing the futuristic aesthetic of modern computer builds.

 Managing your visual style is remarkably quick and simple thanks to the touch-sensitive control button conveniently placed on the upper framework of the speaker chassis. Instead of forcing you to navigate complex software menus or search for awkward hidden mechanical switches, a simple light tap allows you to cycle instantly through 6 diverse lighting presets—including smooth color waves, solid color themes, dynamic shifting cycles, or turning the RGB effects completely off for a clean, professional office look during work hours.

 
 Advanced Clear-Cast Stereo Sound Engineering

 Full-Range Dual Audio Drivers for Exceptional Acoustic Detail

 Beneath the rugged outer shell, the GS520 houses an advanced full-range dual audio drive core meticulously tuned to output balanced acoustic frequencies. Standard budget speakers often struggle with muddy vocals or tinny high notes that distort at higher output levels. Redragon counters this by ensuring their internal speaker diaphragms present crisp, clear treble, distinct mid-tones for crystal-clear vocal clarity, and controlled low frequencies that add crucial punch to explosions, basslines, and game actions.

 This carefully calibrated 2.0 channel stereo configuration creates a wide soundstage, making it easier for competitive multiplayer gamers to identify spatial audio cues and pinpoint directional sound sources. Whether you are listening for approaching vehicles in open-world battle royales or coordinating strategies with team members via voice chat, these speakers deliver robust, room-filling sound quality that remains clean and entirely undistorted even when you turn up the volume level.

 The Redragon GS550 Orpheus 2.0 Channel PC Gaming Speakers deliver a versatile, space-saving audio solution engineered to bring clear stereo sound, vibrant red backlighting, and unique physical flexibility to modern desktop setups. Built with a revolutionary 2-in-1 convertible design, the Orpheus allows gamers to easily switch between a traditional dual-tower stereo setup or connect the two satellite speakers together to form a horizontal desktop soundbar that fits neatly beneath your monitor.

 Meticulously engineered for gaming battle stations, home office desks, and compact media setups, the Redragon GS550 Orpheus balances acoustic clarity with maximum operational convenience. Featuring custom-tuned stereo drivers, an illuminated front-panel rotary volume dial, convenient front headset pass-through ports, and universal plug-and-play USB power, this convertible speaker system provides the rich audio depth and clean aesthetic required to upgrade your PC setup.

 
 
 
 
 Innovative 2-in-1 Convertible Design

 Use as Separate Dual Stereo Towers or Combine into a Horizontal Soundbar

 Adapt your audio setup instantly to match your desk layout. The Redragon GS550 Orpheus features a specialized interlocking 2-in-1 modular frame that lets you choose how you want to display your sound system. Stand the two units upright on either side of your monitor for wide stereo channel separation, or slide and lock them together horizontally to create a sleek, low-profile under-monitor soundbar.

 This physical versatility eliminates desktop clutter and makes the GS550 the ideal audio companion for setups with limited space or multiple monitor arms.

 
 Clear 2.0 Channel Stereo Performance

 Dynamic Dual 3W Drivers for Crisp Gaming Audio and Media Playback

 Equipped with fine-tuned dual 3W full-range dynamic audio drivers , the GS550 Orpheus produces 6W total RMS output, delivering clean, room-filling sound without unwanted distortion.  Volume Down: Press “-” button to decrease the volume.

 Next Track: Press and hold “+” button for 2s to skip track.

 Exit True Wireless Stereo Mode: Press “O” button 3 times to exit TWS pairing.

 SKDY Multi-linkTM Transmitting: Press and hold the “►” and “+” button together for 1s to set speaker as transmitting. Status LED will be purple.

 SKDY Multi-linkTM Receiving: First disconnect speaker from any BT device by single pressing the BT button. Then press and hold the “►” and “+” button together for 1s to set speaker as receiving. Status LED will be green.

 Check Battery Status: The 4 LED indicators show the battery level. Press and hold “+” and “-“ buttons together for 1s, for a more accurate battery level indication. A voice prompt will say the battery level.

 CHARGING 

 Use the USB-CTM cable included to connect the speaker to an appropriate power source to begin charging. The LED indicators will show battery is charging. When all 4 LEDs are ON the battery is fully charged.

 Warning: 

 1. To avoid damage to the speaker and battery, it is important to only use a power source that matches the power requirements listed on the speaker’s rating label.

 2. To avoid overheating, it’s recommended not to place the speaker in direct sunlight, especially while charging and playing music.

25-50% – 1st + 2nd LEDs are ON white, other LEDs are OFF

50-75% – 1st + 2nd + 3rd LEDs are ON white, other LEDs are OFF

75-100% – All LEDs are ON white

 Battery status indication (while charging): 

 0-25% – 1st LED blinks white, other LEDs are OFF

25-50% – 1st LED is ON white, 2nd LED is blinking. Other LEDs are OFF

50-75% – 1st + 2nd LEDs are ON white, 3rd LED is blinking. Other LEDs are OFF

75-99% – 1st + 2nd + 3rd LEDs are ON white, 4th LED is blinking. Other LEDs are OFF

100% – All 4 LEDs are ON white

 TROUBLE SHOOTING 

 Factory Reset: Press and hold “-” and “+” buttons for 10s to initiate factory reset. The speaker will revert to factory settings and all previously paired devices will be deleted. Status LED will blink alternating between blue and red while resetting.

 DUT Mode: If the speaker is charged but not turning ON, or if it is not functioning properly, it may be in DUT mode. Hold the “O” button for 12s to exit DUT mode and reset the speaker.

 Low Battery: If the speaker’s battery is fully depleted, it may not turn ON immediately even

 Features

 Bluetooth v5.3: 
 USB-C Charging Port: 

 
 
 

 Functions 

 Power ON / OFF: Press and hold the “O” button for 2s. If not connected to a BT device or connected but idle (not playing audio) speaker will turn OFF automatically after 15 min.

 Play / Pause: Press the “►” button once to play or pause audio.

 Volume up: Press “+” button to increase the volume.

 Volume Down: Press “-” button to decrease the volume.

 Next Track: Press and hold “+” button for 2s to skip track.

 Previous Track: Press and hold “-” button for 2s to go to last track.

 Bluetooth® Pairing: Press and hold BT Button for 3s to enter BT pairing mode. Speaker will disconnect from any paired BT device and be available to pair to new devices. Speaker will stay in pairing mode for 60s, or until connected. Status LED will blink blue while in BT pairing mode.

 True Wireless Stereo Pairing: Press “O” button 3 times to pair any two SKDY Terrain speakers to play audio in stereo. Status LED will be blue to indicate Right channel and yellow to indicate Left channel.

 Exit True Wireless Stereo Mode: Press “O” button 3 times to exit TWS pairing.

 SKDY Multi-linkTM Mode Transmitting: Press and hold the “►” and “+” button together for 1s to set speaker as transmitting. Status LED will be purple.

 SKDY Multi-linkTM Mode Receiving: First disconnect speaker from any BT device by single pressing the BT button. Then press and hold the “►” and “+” button together for 1s to set speaker as receiving. Status LED will be green.

 Check Battery Status: The 4 LED indicators show the battery level. Press and hold “+” and “-“ buttons together for 1s, for a more accurate battery level indication. A voice prompt will say the battery level.

 CHARGING 

 Use the USB-CTM cable included to connect the speaker to an appropriate power source to begin charging.

 The LED indicators will show battery is charging.

 When all 4 LEDs are ON the battery is fully charged.

 Warning: 

 1. To avoid damage to the speaker and battery, it is important to only use a power source that matches the power requirements listed on the speaker’s rating label.

 2. To avoid overheating, it’s recommended not to place the speaker in direct sunlight, especially while charging and playing music.

 Battery status indication (not charging): 

 0-5% – speaker is OFF all 4 LEDs are OFF

 5-10% – 1st LED blinks red, other LEDs are OFF

 10-25% – 1st LED is ON white, other LEDs are OFF

 25-50% – 1st + 2nd LEDs are ON white, other LEDs are OFF

 50-75% – 1st + 2nd + 3rd LEDs are ON white, other LEDs are OFF

 75-100% – All LEDs are ON white

 Battery status indication (while charging): 

 0-25% – 1st LED blinks white, other LEDs are OFF

 25-50% – 1st LED is ON white, 2nd LED is blinking. Other LEDs are OFF

 50-75% – 1st + 2nd LEDs are ON white, 3rd LED is blinking. Other LEDs are OFF

 75-99% – 1st + 2nd + 3rd LEDs are ON white, 4th LED is blinking. Other LEDs are OFF

 100% – All 4 LEDs are ON white

 TROUBLE SHOOTING 

 Factory Reset: 

 Press and hold “-” and “+” buttons for 10s to initiate factory reset. The speaker will revert to factory settings and all previously paired devices will be deleted. Status LED will blink alternating between blue and red while resetting.

 DUT Mode: 

 If the speaker is charged but not turning ON, or if it is not functioning properly, it may be in DUT mode. Hold the “O” button for 12s to exit DUT mode and reset the speaker.

 Low Battery: 

 If the speaker’s battery is fully depleted, it may not turn ON immediately even when connected to a power source. Please plug the speaker into an appropriate power source and let it charge for at least 10 minutes before turning it ON.

 SPECIFICATIONS 

 # Bluetooth version: 5.3 ®

 # Battery capacity: 7.2V/3350mAh (X2

Apple – AirTag [ A2187 — MX542AM/A – MX542LL/A ] 

 Most features 

 
• 4 pack 

• Water and Dust Resistance ( IP67 ) 

• Built-in speaker 

• Bluetooth 5.0 / NFC connectivity 

• replaceable batteries lasts over a year ( CR2032 coin cell battery ) 

 
 

 

 

 

 AirTag is a supereasy way to keep track of your stuff. Attach one to your keys. Put another in your backpack. And just like that, they’re on your radar in the Find My app , where you can also track down your Apple devices and keep up with friends and family. 

 

 

 

 Ping it. Find it. 

 
 Misplacing something like your wallet doesn’t have to be a big deal when it has AirTag attached. You can play a sound on the built-in speaker by going to the new Items tab in the Find My app, or say “Hey Siri, find my wallet.” If it’s hiding nearby — like under the couch or in the next room — just follow the sound and your search is over. 

 

 
 
 Cold. Warm. Warmer. Hot. 

 If your AirTag is nearby, your iPhone can lead you straight to it with Precision Finding. You‘ll see the distance to your AirTag and the direction to head in — all thanks to Ultra Wideband technology. 

 

 Precision Finding compatible with: 

 
• iPhone 11 

• iPhone 11 Pro and iPhone 11 Pro Max 

• iPhone 12 and iPhone 12 mini 

• iPhone 12 Pro and iPhone 12 Pro Max 

• iPhone 13 and iPhone 13 mini 

• iPhone 13 Pro and iPhone 13 Pro Max 

 

 

 
 How does it work? 

 
 Your AirTag sends out a secure Bluetooth signal that can be detected by nearby devices in the Find My network. These devices send the location of your AirTag to iCloud — then you can go to the Find My app and see it on a map. The whole process is anonymous and encrypted to protect your privacy. And itʼs efficient, so thereʼs no need to worry about battery life or data usage. 

 

 
 
 Lost Mode makes finding things even easier. 

 Just like your other Apple devices, AirTag can be put into Lost Mode . Then, when it’s detected by a device in the network, you’ll automatically get a notification. You can also set it so someone can get your contact info by tapping your AirTag with an NFC-capable smartphone — that’s the same technology that lets people pay for things with their phones.

igeek-q865to.description:
PRESS RELEASE October 13, 2020 

 
 
 Apple introduces HomePod mini: A powerful smart speaker with amazing sound

 
 
 HomePod mini offers a great music listening experience, an intelligent assistant, and smart home capabilities, with built-in privacy and security, in a beautiful compact design

 
 
 
 

 
 HomePod mini, the newest addition to the HomePod family, stands at 3.3 inches tall and offers impressive sound, the intelligence of Siri, and smart home capabilities.

 

 
 
 
 Cupertino, California — Apple today unveiled HomePod mini, the newest addition to the HomePod family that delivers impressive sound, the intelligence of Siri to get things done, and a smart home experience that offers comfort and convenience without complexity. At just 3.3 inches tall, HomePod mini is packed with innovative technologies and advanced software that together enable computational audio to deliver breakthrough audio quality wherever it is placed. HomePod mini will be available in white and space gray at a great price of just $99.

 “HomePod mini has everything customers want in a smart speaker — amazing sound for listening to music, a world-class intelligent assistant that delivers a personal experience to each member of the household, and like every Apple product, it’s designed with privacy and security in mind,” said Bob Borchers, Apple’s vice president of Worldwide Product Marketing. “HomePod mini is the ultimate smart speaker for anyone with an Apple device. It works effortlessly with iPhone to hand off music, answer calls, or deliver personalized listening suggestions, elevates the sound from Apple TV, plays music from a Mac, and so much more. There’s a lot of Apple innovation packed into such a small speaker, all at an affordable price.”

 
 
 
 

 
 HomePod mini uses the intelligence of Siri to deliver a personalized experience for each member of a household.

 

 
 
 
 HomePod mini is designed to work with Apple Music, podcasts, radio stations from iHeartRadio, radio.com, and TuneIn, and in the coming months, popular music services including Pandora and Amazon Music. Multiple HomePod mini speakers work together to stream music or podcasts to multiple rooms, all in perfect sync. By placing two HomePod mini speakers in a single room, a stereo pair can be created for a wide soundstage, filling the space with rich, enveloping sound.

 
 
 
 

 
 A touch surface right on top of HomePod mini lets users play, pause, skip a song, adjust the volume, or talk to Siri.

 

 
 
 
 Amazing Sound 

 HomePod mini delivers an incredibly rich and detailed acoustic experience, using computational audio to deliver peak performance. To achieve big sound out of such a compact design, the Apple S5 chip in HomePod mini works with advanced software to analyze the unique characteristics of the music and apply complex tuning models to optimize loudness, adjust the dynamic range, and control the movement of the driver and passive radiators in real time. The Apple-engineered full-range driver, powered by a neodymium magnet and a pair of force-cancelling passive radiators, enables deep bass and crisp high frequencies.

 Applying the same acoustic principles used to deliver amazing sound in HomePod, HomePod mini features an Apple-designed acoustic waveguide to direct the flow of sound down and out toward the bottom of the speaker for an immersive 360-degree audio experience. This allows customers to place HomePod mini almost anywhere in a room and hear consistent sound. A three-microphone array listens for “Hey Siri,” and a fourth inward-facing microphone helps isolate sound coming from the speaker to improve voice detection when music is playing.

The JBL PartyBox 310 is a portable, high-powered speaker designed for parties and events. It combines powerful sound, dynamic light shows, and portability to deliver an exciting audio-visual experience.

 3.5 hours:

 Dynamic light show with customizable modes:

 IPX4 splash-proof design:

 17.42 kg: 

 
 
 
 

 Key Features

 Powerful Pro Sound 

 
• Equipped with 240W RMS output , the PartyBox 310 delivers powerful, crisp, and immersive audio that’s perfect for any event.

 
 Dynamic Light Show 

 
• Features synchronized LED lights that dance to the beat, with multiple customizable modes for added ambiance.

 
 Extended Battery Life 

 
• Enjoy non-stop music for up to 18 hours on a single charge, ideal for long parties.

 
 Bluetooth and Versatile Connectivity 

 
• Supports Bluetooth streaming , USB playback, and AUX input for seamless audio connections.

 
 Party Ready Design 

 
• The IPX4 splash-proof build makes it suitable for outdoor use, ensuring it withstands splashes and spills.

 
 Portability 

 
• Comes with built-in wheels and a telescopic handle, making it easy to transport despite its powerful size.

 
 Karaoke and DJ Features 

 
• Includes inputs for a microphone and guitar, along with built-in sound effects for added fun.

 
 
 

 The JBL PartyBox 310 is an excellent choice for anyone looking to elevate their parties with booming sound, vibrant visuals, and unmatched portability. Perfect for indoor and outdoor events alike!
